title: Keep every PAM service disabled at package installation
summary: Fresh install has zero Nam-tor PAM blocks. All three distro install hooks (Arch namtor.install, Fedora namtor.spec %post, Debian namtor.postinst) install module/manager binaries, activate systemd socket + D-Bus service, validate mandatory pieces (models, sysuser, units, D-Bus service, PAM module), and print a Settings-based setup message. No PAM config is edited at install time.
